propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires on every call with sub-4096-token prompts even though the anthropic cache floor makes zero/zero counters expected and correct below that threshold
the warning cannot distinguish 'model silently failed to cache a cacheable prompt' from 'prompt was never cacheable' because it lacks a lower bound check
per-call warnings emit ~20 times per rebar review-plan run when caching works at the aggregate level, creating alarm fatigue that trains operators to ignore the signal when genuine defects occur
CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is defined in pass1.py but warn_if_cache_ineffective in structured_run.py references no shared definition, risking drift and inconsistency
the predicate input_tokens > 0 should be input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS so warnings only fire above the cacheability floor
